summary.final_fix: Copy certificate fields only; do not allocate or retain complete-catalogue multiplier buffers in design memo. Added a capacity regression assertion. Other 20 passed tests precede only this localized repair.

reviews.spec: No confirmed correctness or scope defect. Complete scan followed by selection timeout conservatively loses certification; documented limitation.
reviews.standards: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/CODING_STANDARDS found. Final buffer-retention issue repaired and independently reviewed.
other_repaired_findings: Invalidate cached point assessment after every recovery solve, including stack-address reuse.
Do not infer cache interval optimality from the queried theta scale; require source recourse optimality.
Charge feedback intake to shared primal budget without resetting search cooldown or double-counting window time.

limitations: Tiny constructed fixtures only; no production elapsed-time or memory-reduction claim.
New preset inherits the L2 K2 ALNS scope; for K1 or other base counts disable primal_alns, primal_support_completion, indexed_support_completion and cg_primal_feedback.
Complete-catalogue scan certification is published only after candidate selection; selection timeout can discard a completed scan certificate.
Native solver extraction cannot be preempted within the local proximity slice; its wall time is charged and remaining solve budget is checked afterward.
Memo duplicate-cut invalidation is statically reviewed; the exact outer-loop duplicate-hit sequence has no separate forced integration case.
Cross-design RHS reuse is restricted to fixed preprocessed nonconditional integer recourse; numerical recovery profiles may require re-extraction.
Production-preset tiny cases stop early; a controlled 12-iteration fixture exercises feedback/proximity/RHS. Its termination is iteration_limit, not optimality.
